title: Make the CI Check job a required context on dev
description: GCLI-2 added the Check job to .github/workflows/ci.yml (frozen bun install, then typecheck, lint, format:check and test, one step each), but the ruleset on dev (24218126) still requires only Docs and Tracker integrity, so a red Check does not block a merge; the workflow comment and the repository profile both record that. The fleet rule makes a context required only after its first green run on the gated ref, and Check now has one: run 36659158468 on 353dc79, success, on PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#16. The edit is an append to the ruleset's required contexts -- the append-only tightening the operating model's corrected grant paragraph allows, not a relaxation. A repository PATCH from a session has been declined before by the auto-mode classifier as needing the operator's own authorization (the DEC-70 default-branch change), so plan for that path rather than a session edit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The dev ruleset requires the Check context alongside Docs and Tracker integrity, appended only after Check first reported green on the gated ref (run 36659158468 on 353dc79)
The repository profile CI paragraph no longer says Check is not a required context

plan: 1. Verify the green Check run (36659158468 on 353dc79) and read opum-doc grants/ for a live grant naming glyph-cli + modify-branch-ruleset.
2. Append the Check context (integration 15368) to dev ruleset 24218126 with a bare gh api PATCH; leave any permission dialog open for the operator proxy.
3. Read the ruleset back and confirm Docs, Tracker integrity, Check all required.
4. Update the repository profile CI paragraph and the ci.yml comment that carry the old claim.
5. Run the local checks (quest agents --check, lore check), record notes, check both ACs, close GCLI-4.
6. Land the record on dev via PR with required checks green, then promote dev to main and read both refs back.
